description: Create an absence period, e.g. a vacation request (POST /v2/absence-periods). Required: person_id, absence_type_id (list_personio_absence_types), starts_from (ISO date-time). Optional: ends_at, half days (starts_half/ends_half: FIRST_HALF|SECOND_HALF), comment, substitute_id, skip_approval. For day-based types (unit DAY, e.g. vacation) use T00:00:00 times with starts_half FIRST_HALF and ends_half SECOND_HALF, as Personio stores them; end ≠ start and no other clock times (Personio: 'Partial day absence … not allowed'). Check the counted days with get_personio_absence_breakdown. The person needs an absence policy for the type ('No policy is assigned'). Approving is a human decision — needs approval.

ends_half.description: Halber Tag am Ende: FIRST_HALF oder SECOND_HALF

skip_approval.description: Genehmigung in Personio überspringen (nur wenn die Zeit im Quellsystem, z. B. clockin, schon freigegeben ist)

starts_half.description: Halber Tag am Beginn: FIRST_HALF oder SECOND_HALF

name: create_personio_absence
